agents.instruction:
Plan Azerbaijan crawl with given Python script file name /Users/eofmc/EoF/python_crawler/crawler_az_border_status.py 

Coding Rules:
Prevent any external third party dependencies. Use only standard Python modules. 

Important and Forbidden:
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

Available tools:
python_runtime

URLs:
https://www.migration.gov.az/en/press/26,
https://mfa.gov.az/en/news,
https://mfa.gov.az/en/category/announcements,
https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/azerbaijan,
https://en.apa.az/

Use the agent properties. Ignore unrelated navigation, media, social, language, advertising, and institutional boilerplate links. Do not crawl irrelevant links.

Return only a JSON object with these keys:
{
  "scriptPath": "<complete script file name>",
  "stdinJSON": {
    "country": "Azerbaijan",
    "urls": [...],
    "searchEngine": "bing",
    "searchQueries": [...],
    "maxLinksPerPage": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxLinksPerPage>,

    "maxBytesPerUrl": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxBytesPerUrl>,
    "maxTextCharsPerUrl": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxTextCharsPerUrl>,
    "maxPages": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxPages>,
    "maxDepth": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxDepth>,
    "maxCrawlDepth": <copy from agent property stdinJSON.maxDepth>,
    "relevantTerms": [...]
  },
  "timeoutSeconds": 120,

}
